bumpRationale: Patch: weekly automated audit. Closes a High-severity HTML/script-injection gap (CWE-79) found in the shared notification-template library (src/lib/notifications/templates.js, 7 templates) and in Asistencia.jsx's absence-notification email — a partial fix for the same class of bug had already landed for one email (CrearBitacora.jsx) via an untracked direct commit to main (a5a663d, no PR, no version bump); this release completes it with a shared, unit-tested escapeHtml() helper (src/lib/htmlEscape.js) applied consistently everywhere the pattern existed, plus 5 new regression tests. Also closes 5 dependency advisories via non-breaking npm audit fix (nanoid, js-yaml, dompurify, socket.io-parser, brace-expansion) — the brace-expansion fix closes the High-severity item carried forward as accepted risk from v1.7.1. The moderate react-router/react-router-dom advisory remains accepted risk (unchanged rationale: requires a major v6→v7 upgrade; not reachable — client-only SPA, no externally-controlled navigation targets). See docs/security-audit-2026-08-10.md. No entity schema, RLS rule, permission, tenant-isolation, or AI/RAG behavior changed. 276 tests pass (271 + 5 new); lint clean; typecheck clean; RLS validation green (32 entities); release gate green (23/23); build succeeds.

architecture.runtime: browser (client-side only; no application server) + Base44 backend functions for privileged mutations
architecture.enforcementBoundary: base44 Row-Level Security (entity + field-level RLS) in base44/entities/*.jsonc + service-role backend functions in base44/functions/*
architecture.language: JavaScript / JSX (type-checked via jsconfig); Deno TypeScript for backend functions

assistantSkills.note: The sibling claude-skills repo holds 48 generic Anthropic/Claude authoring skills (pdf, xlsx, brainstorming, math-olympiad, ...). They are assistant tooling used to BUILD Liuma — NOT features of the application, not integrated into it, and not listed in the user manual.
